reasoning.text: Decelerate to yield to a pedestrian crossing the road ahead from the right.
Decelerate to yield to the crossing cyclist and prepare to yield at the upcoming intersection.
Decelerate to maintain a safe following distance as a cyclist cuts into our lane ahead.
Accelerate to resume cruising speed as the preceding vehicle vacates our lane.
Accelerate and proceed through the intersection to follow our route, as the cyclist has cleared our path.
Accelerate and proceed straight along our lane to follow our route, as the lead vehicle has cleared our path.
Accelerate to resume cruising speed as the lead vehicle pulls away and clears our lane.
Decelerate and shift left to provide safe clearance for the cyclist riding along the right side of our lane.
